description: This file defines the enumeration and utility functions related to UI actions in the OpenClaw Canvas A2 UI. It includes nested structs for message context, methods for extracting action names, sanitizing tag values, formatting messages, and dispatching UI status updates via JavaScript.

classes.name: OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction
classes.description: An enum encapsulating UI action related data, including nested structs for message context and methods for handling actions and communicating with the UI layer.

methods.name: extractActionName
methods.description: Extracts the action name from a user action dictionary by checking keys 'name' and 'action'.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValue
methods.description: Sanitizes input string for safe usage as a tag value, trimming, replacing spaces, and allowing only certain characters.

methods.name: compactJSON
methods.description: Serializes a given object into compact JSON string if valid.

methods.name: formatAgentMessage
methods.description: Formats a status message string from a given agent message context.

methods.name: jsDispatchA2UIActionStatus
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code to dispatch a UI action status event with the given ID, success flag, and error message.
